No <form> element anywhere in this section. The old findLoginForm returned null here and autofill silently did nothing.

2. Field inside a scrollable sub-container

Scroll inside the box. Icons are positioned in document-absolute coordinates, so this is the known drift case — check whether the icon stays on its field.

The eye button sits where our icon goes. The site must stay usable.
